thread.title: All 30 Dow stocks gain ground, led by Home Depot and Caterpillar - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: All 30 Dow stocks gain ground, led by Home Depot and Caterpillar - MarketWatch
text:
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +1.27% shot up 329 points , or 1.4%, in midday trade Friday, will all 30 components contributing to gains. The blue-chip barometer, on track for the highest close since in six weeks, has now run up 13% since it closed at a 14-month low on Dec. 24. Of the biggest gainers, shares of Home Depot Inc. HD, +2.44% rallied 2.9%, Caterpillar Inc. CAT, +2.55% climbed 2.8% and DowDuPont Inc. DWDP, +2.40% tacked on 2.3%. The most-active Dow component was Apple Inc.'s stock AAPL, +0.73% which rose 0.8%.
